integrity: The exact scalar skew transition kernel and general annealed/quenched variance decomposition are cited prior work; only the skew-family exact optimization, strict nonzero gap, and full sharp long-time coefficient are proposed as new. The analytical proof rather than numerical verification supports quantifiers and asymptotic statements. An independent novelty review remains necessary.
scientific_limitations: Independent finite-particle skew Brownian motion on the whole line, uniform initial positions in a finite counting interval, fixed positive diffusivity and length. No finite-permeability Robin membrane, interacting particles, cumulative first passage, noisy parameter estimation or uniqueness of the sign-reversal time is claimed.
title: Sharp annealed–quenched memory suppression at a skew Brownian junction
